summary: #569: add stabilization label + early skip in heavy-release job for review-response / docs-only pushes on release-v* branches (reduce CI waste during finalization and feedback addressing). Feedback gate already lightweight/re-runnable.
migration_impact: Repos with custom CI can adopt a 'stabilization' label (or Documentation) to keep review pushes cheap on release branches. The heavy jobs remain for true packaging Release PRs.
migration_guidance: 1. When responding to review on a Release PR / release-v branch, apply 'stabilization' label (or keep Documentation) to avoid full heavy matrix.
2. Update any local branch protection or status checks expectations if you rely on heavy steps always running.
agent_notes: For Release PR review rounds or thread resolve pushes, prefer stabilization label to keep velocity high. Still run gh plate release status first and use pr-babysit for the loop.
